verses.he: הֹוד֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִּשְׁמֹ֑ו הֹודִ֥יעוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילֹותָֽיו׃
verses.ar: اِحْمَدُوا ٱلرَّبَّ. ٱدْعُوا بِٱسْمِهِ. عَرِّفُوا بَيْنَ ٱلْأُمَمِ بِأَعْمَالِهِ.
verses.en: O give thanks unto the LORD, call upon His name; make known His doings among the peoples.
verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
verses.web: Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

verses.he: שִֽׁירוּ־לֹ֖ו זַמְּרוּ־לֹ֑ו שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּכָל־נִפְלְאֹותָֽיו׃
verses.ar: غَنُّوا لَهُ. رَنِّمُوا لَهُ. أَنْشِدُوا بِكُلِّ عَجَائِبِهِ.
verses.en: Sing unto Him, sing praises unto Him; speak ye of all His marvellous works.
verses.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.web: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

verses.he: הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֹׁ֑ו יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב ׀ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: ٱفْتَخِرُوا بِٱسْمِهِ ٱلْقُدُّوسِ. لِتَفْرَحْ قُلُوبُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَلْتَمِسُونَ ٱلرَّبَّ.
verses.en: Glory ye in His holy name; let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
verses.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
verses.web: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.

verses.he: דִּרְשׁ֣וּ יְהוָ֣ה וְעֻזֹּ֑ו בַּקְּשׁ֖וּ פָנָ֣יו תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.ar: اُطْلُبُوا ٱلرَّبَّ وَقُدْرَتَهُ. ٱلْتَمِسُوا وَجْهَهُ دَائِمًا.
verses.en: Seek ye the LORD and His strength; seek His face continually.
verses.kjv: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
verses.web: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

verses.he: זִכְר֗וּ נִפְלְאֹותָ֥יו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֑ה מֹ֝פְתָ֗יו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִֽיו׃
verses.ar: ٱذْكُرُوا عَجَائِبَهُ ٱلَّتِي صَنَعَ، آيَاتِهِ وَأَحْكَامَ فِيهِ،
verses.en: Remember His marvellous works that He hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth;
verses.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.web: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

verses.he: זֶ֭רַע אַבְרָהָ֣ם עַבְדֹּ֑ו בְּנֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֣ב בְּחִירָֽיו׃
verses.ar: يَا ذُرِّيَّةَ إِبْراهِيمَ عَبْدِهِ، يَا بَنِي يَعْقُوبَ مُخْتَارِيهِ.
verses.en: O ye seed of Abraham His servant, ye children of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.kjv: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
verses.web: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

verses.he: ה֭וּא יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ בְּכָל־הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָֽיו׃
verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلرَّبُّ إِلَهُنَا فِي كُلِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَحْكَامُهُ.
verses.en: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
verses.kjv: He [is] the LORD our God: his judgments [are] in all the earth.
verses.web: He is Yahweh, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

verses.he: זָכַ֣ר לְעֹולָ֣ם בְּרִיתֹ֑ו דָּבָ֥ר צִ֝וָּ֗ה לְאֶ֣לֶף דֹּֽור׃
verses.ar: ذَكَرَ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ عَهْدَهُ، كَلَامًا أَوْصَى بِهِ إِلَى أَلْفِ دَوْرٍ،
verses.en: He hath remembered His covenant for ever, the word which He commanded to a thousand generations;
verses.kjv: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word [which] he commanded to a thousand generations.
verses.web: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּ֭רַת אֶת־אַבְרָהָ֑ם וּשְׁב֖וּעָתֹ֣ו לְיִשְׂחָֽק׃
verses.ar: ٱلَّذِي عَاهَدَ بِهِ إِبْراهِيمَ، وَقَسَمَهُ لِإِسْحاقَ،
verses.en: The covenant which He made with Abraham, and His oath unto Isaac;
verses.kjv: Which [covenant] he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
verses.web: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

verses.he: וַיַּֽעֲמִידֶ֣הָ לְיַעֲקֹ֣ב לְחֹ֑ק לְ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּרִ֣ית עֹולָֽם׃
verses.ar: فَثَبَّتَهُ لِيَعْقُوبَ فَرِيضَةً، وَلِإِسْرَائِيلَ عَهْدًا أَبَدِيًّا،
verses.en: And He established it unto Jacob for a statute, to Israel for an everlasting covenant;
verses.kjv: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, [and] to Israel [for] an everlasting covenant:
verses.web: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

verses.he: לֵאמֹ֗ר לְךָ֗ אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־אֶֽרֶץ־כְּנָ֑עַן חֶ֝֗בֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶֽם׃
verses.ar: قَائِلًا: «لَكَ أُعْطِي أَرْضَ كَنْعَانَ حَبْلَ مِيرَاثِكُمْ».
verses.en: Saying: 'Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance.'
verses.kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
verses.web: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

verses.he: בִּֽ֭הְיֹותָם מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּ֝מְעַ֗ט וְגָרִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.ar: إِذْ كَانُوا عَدَدًا يُحْصَى، قَلِيلِينَ وَغُرَبَاءَ فِيهَا.
verses.en: When they were but a few men in number. Yea, very few, and sojourners in it,
verses.kjv: When they were [but] a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
verses.web: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

verses.he: וַֽ֭יִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגֹּ֣וי אֶל־גֹּ֑וי מִ֝מַּמְלָכָ֗ה אֶל־עַ֥ם אַחֵֽר׃
verses.ar: ذَهَبُوا مِنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَى أُمَّةٍ، مِنْ مَمْلَكَةٍ إِلَى شَعْبٍ آخَرَ.
verses.en: And when they went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people,
verses.kjv: When they went from one nation to another, from [one] kingdom to another people;
verses.web: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

verses.he: לֹֽא־הִנִּ֣יחַ אָדָ֣ם לְעָשְׁקָ֑ם וַיֹּ֖וכַח עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם מְלָכִֽים׃
verses.ar: فَلَمْ يَدَعْ إِنْسَانًا يَظْلِمُهُمْ، بَلْ وَبَّخَ مُلُوكًا مِنْ أَجْلِهِمْ،
verses.en: He suffered no man to do them wrong, yea, for their sake He reproved kings:
verses.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
verses.web: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

verses.he: אַֽל־תִּגְּע֥וּ בִמְשִׁיחָ֑י וְ֝לִנְבִיאַי אַל־תָּרֵֽעוּ׃
verses.ar: قَائِلًا: «لَا تَمَسُّوا مُسَحَائِي، وَلَا تُسِيئُوا إِلَى أَنْبِيَائِي».
verses.en: 'Touch not Mine anointed ones, and do My prophets no harm.'
verses.kjv: [Saying], Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.web: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

verses.he: וַיִּקְרָ֣א רָ֭עָב עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ כָּֽל־מַטֵּה־לֶ֥חֶם שָׁבָֽר׃
verses.ar: دَعَا بِٱلْجُوعِ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ. كَسَرَ قِوَامَ ٱلْخُبْزِ كُلَّهُ.
verses.en: And He called a famine upon the land; He broke the whole staff of bread.
verses.kjv: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
verses.web: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

verses.he: שָׁלַ֣ח לִפְנֵיהֶ֣ם אִ֑ישׁ לְ֝עֶ֗בֶד נִמְכַּ֥ר יֹוסֵֽף׃
verses.ar: أَرْسَلَ أَمَامَهُمْ رَجُلًا. بِيعَ يُوسُفُ عَبْدًا.
verses.en: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant;
verses.kjv: He sent a man before them, [even] Joseph, [who] was sold for a servant:
verses.web: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

verses.he: עִנּ֣וּ בַכֶּ֣בֶל *רַגְלָיו (רַגְלֹ֑ו) בַּ֝רְזֶ֗ל בָּ֣אָה נַפְשֹֽׁו׃
verses.ar: آذَوْا بِٱلْقَيْدِ رِجْلَيْهِ. فِي ٱلْحَدِيدِ دَخَلَتْ نَفْسُهُ،
verses.en: His feet they hurt with fetters, his person was laid in iron;
verses.kjv: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:
verses.web: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

verses.he: עַד־עֵ֥ת בֹּֽא־דְבָרֹ֑ו אִמְרַ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְרָפָֽתְהוּ׃
verses.ar: إِلَى وَقْتِ مَجِيءِ كَلِمَتِهِ. قَوْلُ ٱلرَّبِّ ٱمْتَحَنَهُ.
verses.en: Until the time that his word came to pass, the word of the LORD tested him.
verses.kjv: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
verses.web: until the time that his word happened, and Yahweh’s word proved him true.

verses.he: שָׁ֣לַח מֶ֭לֶךְ וַיַתִּירֵ֑הוּ מֹשֵׁ֥ל עַ֝מִּ֗ים וַֽיְפַתְּחֵֽהוּ׃
verses.ar: أَرْسَلَ ٱلْمَلِكُ فَحَلَّهُ. أَرْسَلَ سُلْطَانُ ٱلشَّعْبِ فَأَطْلَقَهُ.
verses.en: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the peoples, and set him free.
verses.kjv: The king sent and loosed him; [even] the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
verses.web: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

verses.he: שָׂמֹ֣ו אָדֹ֣ון לְבֵיתֹ֑ו וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בְּכָל־קִנְיָנֹֽו׃
verses.ar: أَقَامَهُ سَيِّدًا عَلَى بَيْتِهِ، وَمُسَلَّطًا عَلَى كُلِّ مُلْكِهِ،
verses.en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his possessions;
verses.kjv: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
verses.web: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

verses.he: לֶאְסֹ֣ר שָׂרָ֣יו בְּנַפְשֹׁ֑ו וּזְקֵנָ֥יו יְחַכֵּֽם׃
verses.ar: لِيَأْسُرَ رُؤَسَاءَهُ حَسَبَ إِرَادَتِهِ وَيُعَلِّمَ مَشَايِخَهُ حِكْمَةً.
verses.en: To bind his princes at his pleasure, and teach his elders wisdom.
verses.kjv: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
verses.web: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

verses.he: וַיָּבֹ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ֝יַעֲקֹ֗ב גָּ֣ר בְּאֶֽרֶץ־חָֽם׃
verses.ar: فَجَاءَ إِسْرَائِيلُ إِلَى مِصْرَ، وَيَعْقُوبُ تَغَرَّبَ فِي أَرْضِ حَامٍ.
verses.en: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.kjv: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
verses.web: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

verses.he: וַיֶּ֣פֶר אֶת־עַמֹּ֣ו מְאֹ֑ד וַ֝יַּֽעֲצִמֵהוּ מִצָּרָֽיו׃
verses.ar: جَعَلَ شَعْبَهُ مُثْمِرًا جِدًّا، وَأَعَزَّهُ عَلَى أَعْدَائِهِ.
verses.en: And He increased His people greatly, and made them too mighty for their adversaries.
verses.kjv: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
verses.web: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

verses.he: הָפַ֣ךְ לִ֭בָּם לִשְׂנֹ֣א עַמֹּ֑ו לְ֝הִתְנַכֵּ֗ל בַּעֲבָדָֽיו׃
verses.ar: حَوَّلَ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِيُبْغِضُوا شَعْبَهُ، لِيَحْتَالُوا عَلَى عَبِيدِهِ.
verses.en: He turned their heart to hate His people, to deal craftily with His servants.
verses.kjv: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
verses.web: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

verses.he: שָׁ֭לַח מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדֹּ֑ו אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּֽחַר־בֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: أَرْسَلَ مُوسَى عَبْدَهُ وَهارُونَ ٱلَّذِي ٱخْتَارَهُ.
verses.en: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron whom He had chosen.
verses.kjv: He sent Moses his servant; [and] Aaron whom he had chosen.
verses.web: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

verses.he: שָֽׂמוּ־בָ֭ם דִּבְרֵ֣י אֹתֹותָ֑יו וּ֝מֹפְתִ֗ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָֽם׃
verses.ar: أَقَامَا بَيْنَهُمْ كَلَامَ آيَاتِهِ، وَعَجَائِبَ فِي أَرْضِ حَامٍ.
verses.en: They wrought among them His manifold signs, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.kjv: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
verses.web: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.he: שָׁ֣לַֽח חֹ֭שֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁ֑ךְ וְלֹֽא־מָ֝ר֗וּ אֶת־*דְּבָרָוו (דְּבָרֹֽו)׃
verses.ar: أَرْسَلَ ظُلْمَةً فَأَظْلَمَتْ، وَلَمْ يَعْصَوْا كَلَامَهُ.
verses.en: He sent darkness, and it was dark; and they rebelled not against His word.
verses.kjv: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
verses.web: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

verses.he: הָפַ֣ךְ אֶת־מֵימֵיהֶ֣ם לְדָ֑ם וַ֝יָּ֗מֶת אֶת־דְּגָתָֽם׃
verses.ar: حَوَّلَ مِيَاهَهُمْ إِلَى دَمٍ وَقَتَلَ أَسْمَاكَهُمْ.
verses.en: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
verses.kjv: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
verses.web: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

verses.he: שָׁרַ֣ץ אַרְצָ֣ם צְפַרְדְּעִ֑ים בְּ֝חַדְרֵ֗י מַלְכֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: أَفَاضَتْ أَرْضُهُمْ ضَفَادِعَ حَتَّى فِي مَخَادِعِ مُلُوكِهِمْ.
verses.en: Their land swarmed with frogs, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.kjv: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
verses.web: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

verses.he: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א עָרֹ֑ב כִּ֝נִּ֗ים בְּכָל־גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.ar: أَمَرَ فَجَاءَ ٱلذُّبَّانُ وَٱلْبَعُوضُ فِي كُلِّ تُخُومِهِمْ.
verses.en: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, and gnats in all their borders.
verses.kjv: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, [and] lice in all their coasts.
verses.web: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

verses.he: נָתַ֣ן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶ֣ם בָּרָ֑ד אֵ֖שׁ לֶהָבֹ֣ות בְּאַרְצָֽם׃
verses.ar: جَعَلَ أَمْطَارَهُمْ بَرَدًا وَنَارًا مُلْتَهِبَةً فِي أَرْضِهِمْ.
verses.en: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
verses.kjv: He gave them hail for rain, [and] flaming fire in their land.
verses.web: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

verses.he: וַיַּ֣ךְ גַּ֭פְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָ֑ם וַ֝יְשַׁבֵּ֗ר עֵ֣ץ גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.ar: ضَرَبَ كُرُومَهُمْ وَتِينَهُمْ، وَكَسَّرَ كُلَّ أَشْجَارِ تُخُومِهِمْ.
verses.en: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees; and broke the trees of their borders.
verses.kjv: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
verses.web: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

verses.he: אָ֭מַר וַיָּבֹ֣א אַרְבֶּ֑ה וְ֝יֶ֗לֶק וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּֽר׃
verses.ar: أَمَرَ فَجَاءَ ٱلْجَرَادُ وَغَوْغَاءُ بِلَا عَدَدٍ،
verses.en: He spoke, and the locust came, and the canker-worm without number,
verses.kjv: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
verses.web: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.

verses.he: וַיֹּ֣אכַל כָּל־עֵ֣שֶׂב בְּאַרְצָ֑ם וַ֝יֹּ֗אכַל פְּרִ֣י אַדְמָתָֽם׃
verses.ar: فَأَكَلَ كُلَّ عُشْبٍ فِي بِلَادِهِمْ، وَأَكَلَ أَثْمَارَ أَرْضِهِمْ.
verses.en: And did eat up every herb in their land, and did eat up the fruit of their ground.
verses.kjv: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
verses.web: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

verses.he: וַיַּ֣ךְ כָּל־בְּכֹ֣ור בְּאַרְצָ֑ם רֵ֝אשִׁ֗ית לְכָל־אֹונָֽם׃
verses.ar: قَتَلَ كُلَّ بِكْرٍ فِي أَرْضِهِمْ، أَوَائِلَ كُلِّ قُوَّتِهِمْ.
verses.en: He smote also all the first-born in their land, the first-fruits of all their strength.
verses.kjv: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
verses.web: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

verses.he: וַֽ֭יֹּוצִיאֵם בְּכֶ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֖ין בִּשְׁבָטָ֣יו כֹּושֵֽׁל׃
verses.ar: فَأَخْرَجَهُمْ بِفِضَّةٍ وَذَهَبٍ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ فِي أَسْبَاطِهِمْ عَاثِرٌ.
verses.en: And He brought them forth with silver and gold; and there was none that stumbled among His tribes.
verses.kjv: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and [there was] not one feeble [person] among their tribes.
verses.web: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

verses.he: שָׂמַ֣ח מִצְרַ֣יִם בְּצֵאתָ֑ם כִּֽי־נָפַ֖ל פַּחְדָּ֣ם עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: فَرِحَتْ مِصْرُ بِخُرُوجِهِمْ، لِأَنَّ رُعْبَهُمْ سَقَطَ عَلَيْهِمْ.
verses.en: Egypt was glad when they departed; for the fear of them had fallen upon them.
verses.kjv: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
verses.web: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

verses.he: פָּרַ֣שׂ עָנָ֣ן לְמָסָ֑ךְ וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ לְהָאִ֥יר לָֽיְלָה׃
verses.ar: بَسَطَ سَحَابًا سَجْفًا، وَنَارًا لِتُضِيءَ ٱللَّيْلَ.
verses.en: He spread a cloud for a screen; and fire to give light in the night.
verses.kjv: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
verses.web: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

verses.he: שָׁאַ֣ל וַיָּבֵ֣א שְׂלָ֑ו וְלֶ֥חֶם שָׁ֝מַ֗יִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵֽם׃
verses.ar: سَأَلُوا فَأَتَاهُمْ بِٱلسَّلْوَى، وَخُبْزَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ أَشْبَعَهُمْ.
verses.en: They asked, and He brought quails, and gave them in plenty the bread of heaven.
verses.kjv: [The people] asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
verses.web: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

verses.he: פָּ֣תַח צ֭וּר וַיָּז֣וּבוּ מָ֑יִם הָ֝לְכ֗וּ בַּצִּיֹּ֥ות נָהָֽר׃
verses.ar: شَقَّ ٱلصَّخْرَةَ فَٱنْفَجَرَتِ ٱلْمِيَاهُ. جَرَتْ فِي ٱلْيَابِسَةِ نَهْرًا.
verses.en: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; they ran, a river in the dry places.
verses.kjv: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places [like] a river.
verses.web: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

verses.he: כִּֽי־זָ֭כַר אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר קָדְשֹׁ֑ו אֶֽת־אַבְרָהָ֥ם עַבְדֹּֽו׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ كَلِمَةَ قُدْسِهِ مَعَ إِبْراهِيمَ عَبْدِهِ،
verses.en: For He remembered His holy word unto Abraham His servant;
verses.kjv: For he remembered his holy promise, [and] Abraham his servant.
verses.web: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

verses.he: וַיֹּוצִ֣א עַמֹּ֣ו בְשָׂשֹׂ֑ון בְּ֝רִנָּ֗ה אֶת־בְּחִירָֽיו׃
verses.ar: فَأَخْرَجَ شَعْبَهُ بِٱبْتِهَاجٍ، وَمُخْتَارِيهِ بِتَرَنُّمٍ.
verses.en: And He brought forth His people with joy, His chosen ones with singing.
verses.kjv: And he brought forth his people with joy, [and] his chosen with gladness:
verses.web: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

verses.he: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם אַרְצֹ֣ות גֹּויִ֑ם וַעֲמַ֖ל לְאֻמִּ֣ים יִירָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.ar: وَأَعْطَاهُمْ أَرَاضِيَ ٱلْأُمَمِ، وَتَعَبَ ٱلشُّعُوبِ وَرِثُوهُ،
verses.en: And He gave them the lands of the nations, and they took the labour of the peoples in possession;
verses.kjv: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
verses.web: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

verses.he: בַּעֲב֤וּר ׀ יִשְׁמְר֣וּ חֻ֭קָּיו וְתֹורֹתָ֥יו יִנְצֹ֗רוּ הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃
verses.ar: لِكَيْ يَحْفَظُوا فَرَائِضَهُ وَيُطِيعُوا شَرَائِعَهُ. هَلِّلُويَا.
verses.en: That they might keep His statutes, and observe His laws. Hallelujah.
verses.kjv: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.
verses.web: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise Yah!
